name: rcedit
description: Local no-op stub for the real 'rcedit' npm package. rcedit edits resource metadata (icon, version info) in a Windows .exe — it only runs during Windows installer packaging, which this macOS JarBench dev build never performs. The real package's tarball bundles a Windows executable, which this network's security gateway blocks/resets in transit; this stub exists so 'npm install' can complete for macOS development without needing that download. Do not use this for an actual Windows package build.
